projects.name: Resume Analyzer

projects.proposedSolution: An automated backend analysis service built with Python and FastAPI that extracts structured sections from resumes, compares skills against role requirements, and generates actionable evaluation feedback.

projects.name: Local RAG Chatbot
projects.shortDescription: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) conversational system engineered to query local technical documents and knowledge bases with grounded context.
projects.problemStatement: Standard LLM interactions suffer from hallucinations and lack access to private, local engineering documentation without sending sensitive files to third-party servers.
projects.proposedSolution: A modular local RAG pipeline that ingests custom documents, splits text into semantic chunks, indexes vector embeddings, and retrieves top-k relevant passages to ground LLM responses.
projects.architecture: Document Loader -> Semantic Text Chunker -> Embedding Model -> Local Vector Store -> Context Retriever -> LLM Response Generator.
features: Local document ingestion and configurable chunk size/overlap
Vector similarity search for high-precision context retrieval
Grounded prompt synthesis to minimize hallucinated answers
